verdict.rationale: Bulk data export is a fair question for a virtual mailbox service, but the pack documents no bulk export of scans or mail-history metadata. It shows only that scans are stored as PDFs in cloud storage, plus a generic API and a Zapier connector. Neither the API nor Zapier is documented as exporting archives, so they are developer building blocks rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an operator, I can export my scans and mail history in bulk — PDFs and metadata leave the platform when I do
